game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern, a cavern of glowing mushrooms: the dwarf scout must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Continue Gate: Use continue to skip spoiled rope coils but keep the loop running.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern: a cavern of glowing mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Cavern, repeat each round: Use continue to skip spoiled rope coils but keep the loop running. Each round, zombies strike the supply cache, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the skipped_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the supply cache from zombies in Mushroom Cavern: keep the skipped_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: skipped_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 41-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Continue Gate
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Continue Gate' (Week 4 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Mushroom Cavern'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how skipped_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against zombies in Mushroom Cavern.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 41 seconds while skipped_ok > 0.
